summary: Telecom Argentina S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting that the Argentine Antitrust Tribunal conditionally approved its acquisition of exclusive control over Telefónica Móviles Argentina S.A. and its subsidiaries. The approval requires divestiture remedies: transfer of at least 6,000,000 mobile customers (4,000,000 in AMBA, 2,000,000 elsewhere) plus related spectrum, and 211,400 residential internet subscribers in 28 localities across five provinces. Behavioral remedies apply in corporate and wholesale segments. The filing is a material event update following the earlier April 30, 2026 notice. No financial terms (price per share, premium, implied value) are disclosed. No board recommendation or named advisors. The regulatory conditionality and required asset divestitures represent key close-risk factors; watch for appointment of a divestiture trustee and progress on customer/spectrum transfers.
